:::{#exr-additive-product}
#### Testing whether $x_1 x_2$ is additive

An [additive function](#def-additive-function) can be evaluated at $\vx + \vy$
by evaluating it at $\vx$ and at $\vy$ separately,
so additivity is worth checking before splitting a computation that way.
Let $f: \reals^2 \to \reals$ be $f(\vx) = x_1 x_2$.

Is $f$ [additive](#def-additive-function)?

::: {.callout-tip}
#### Hint

Try $\vx = (1, 0)$ and $\vy = (0, 1)$ in @def-additive-function.

:::
